summary: First-run testing of Task 4.1 Beta Feedback & Metrics module. Backend (7/7 pytest cases passing against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with real 2FA flow) and frontend (end-to-end dialog + metrics + scope toggle + mobile layout) all pass. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: beta.py: GET /beta/metrics scans up to 10000 consultations and 5000 feedback and recomputes all stats in Python on every request. Fine for beta scale but will not scale - consider Mongo aggregation pipeline when corpus grows.

beta.py app_seconds(): if ai_sec is None but finalized_at is set, the review time is still added via sum(app_seconds(c) for c in timed) - but 'timed' filter is c.get('ai_sec'), so OK. However total_saved_min only considers 'timed' consultations; non-timed legacy reports are counted in reports KPI but excluded from saved time (correctly), yet the KPI card label says 'Media per visita · X min in totale' which could be misleading when most visits are not timed. Minor UX note.
BetaMetrics.jsx: api.betaMetrics() has no error toast; silently sets data=null and the whole section becomes invisible. Add an error state or at least a log so failures aren't hidden from the doctor.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 3 TEST_-prefixed feedback entries during tests (areas: pdf, trascrizione). Safe to leave or purge from db.feedback where text LIKE 'TEST_%' (field is sealed, filter on doctor_id + text after unseal if cleanup needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_beta_full.py uses external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and handles the 2FA login via tests/totp_code.py (requires /root/.venv/bin/python because pyotp/pymongo live there). The internal /app/backend/tests/test_beta.py still points to localhost:8001 and only works if 2FA happens to be disabled - keep test_beta_full.py as the regression file. UI selectors verified: feedback-beta-button, feedback-dialog, feedback-star-1..5, feedback-rating-label, feedback-area-{trascrizione|pdf|agenda|cassa|altro}, feedback-text-input, feedback-submit-btn, feedback-thanks, feedback-close-btn, beta-metrics, beta-kpi-{reports|saved|feedback|rating}-value, beta-area-{area}, beta-recent, beta-scope-{mine|all}, beta-feedback-btn. Scope toggle values observed: all.reports=11 (legacy seeded), mine.reports=0 (no new consultations created in this run).
